fields.description:
If activated, Journal Entries can be created manually (or via Bank Reconciliation Tool). If activated, you can save some clicks (e. g. by reconciling a Bank Withdrawal directly from the Bank Reconciliation Tool). On the other hand, you are at risk to create the same withdrawal twice: Once via Cash Transaction and once via Bank Reconciliation Tool. If you leave this setting disabled and you use a Bank Reconciliation Tool, you need to create a Cash Transaction first and reconcile the Bank Transaction (in the Bank Reconciliation Tool) with the resulting Journal Entry.
This setting only considers cash accounts.
fields.label: Allow manual Journal Entries
